name: keepup
description: You can't keep up with AI. Your product can. Checks your code against everything new in AI and tells you the few changes worth making.

api_key.title: Account key (optional)
api_key.description: Optional. Without it, keepup checks your code for retired and retiring models. With your keepup account key, which starts with kup_, a build of keepup that has a server also asks it for the levers that fit your code. The free build has no server, so it never uses the key.
